purpose: Run a new human, non-pathogen exploratory receptor-ensemble replication on PARP1 after the HIVPR and DPP4 branches were externally terminated before any target benchmark docking.
evidence_timing: Frozen after public DUD-E target-table and RCSB entry-count feasibility checks, but before PARP1 archive download, source-file inspection, coordinate retrieval, ligand allocation, docking, QUBO fitting, or enrichment evaluation.

dpp4.termination_reason: user preference for a different non-toxic protein target

prior_branch_record.replacement_status: PARP1 is a new preregistered exploratory extension, not a silent substitution into the original three-target confirmatory gate.

selection_criteria: monomeric catalytic domain with ordinary noncovalent small-molecule inhibitor complexes
no required catalytic-metal, covalent, or specialized cofactor scoring
at least 498 clustered DUD-E actives for unchanged panel sizes
at least 25 public RCSB X-ray entries before coordinate filtering

ligand_panel.split_group: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with duplicate source IDs before allocation
ligand_panel.failure_action: Stop PARP1 before receptor production docking if all 498 required active molecules cannot be assigned to molecule-, source-, canonical-SMILES-, and scaffold-disjoint panels.

receptor_protocol.coordinate_selection_data: coordinates and metadata only; activity labels and benchmark docking scores prohibited
receptor_protocol.pre_redocking_selection: deterministic max-min active-site geometry with the DUD-E reference included
receptor_protocol.post_redocking_final_selection: from passing candidates, deterministically select 16 by max-min active-site geometry; no activity labels or benchmark scores
receptor_protocol.failure_action: If fewer than 16 of 24 candidates pass the fixed redocking gate, report a PARP1 technical failure without adding structures after reading enrichment results.

production_protocol.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair; selected receptor subsets use min_score

interpretation_boundary: PARP1 can provide prospective exploratory evidence for receptor-ensemble and QUBO behavior. It cannot erase the HIVPR or DPP4 records, retroactively satisfy the original three-target confirmatory gate, establish quantum advantage, or establish experimental binding.
